description: MTP drafter precision study: 31B UD-Q4_K_XL target with the assistant Q8_0 drafter (production), Unsloth BF16 and Unsloth Q8_0 drafters (unsloth/gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF MTP/, revision c1ac76e99d5513b141e8adde7288b85c3f9c32ec). Fixed 15-draft cycles with --draft-trace label every row exactly (greedy 0/1, sampled min(1, p/q)); expected accepted drafts per cycle = sum_i prod_{j<=i} a_j over drafted rows; cycles with prompt-lookup copies excluded; 95% intervals from 2000 bootstrap resamples over requests.
dataset: The 46 requests of the 2026-10-20 calibration study (draft_policy_bench.py workloads): sampled at temperature 1, top-k 64, top-p 0.95 (12 prose x 256, 12 story x 128, 6 code-write x 384, 3 code-edit x 384, 3 essay x 400 over a ~31K-token document) and greedy (6 prose, code-write, code-edit, repetitive, essay).
identical_arms: q8 and q8u traces are byte-identical; q8 reproduces the 2026-10-20 study figures exactly
